title: Atatürk Cultural Center Demolition and Rebuild, Istanbul
summary: Turkey's iconic Atatürk Cultural Center on Taksim Square — a Cold War-era symbol of secular modernism — was demolished in 2018 after years of political controversy and rebuilt as a neo-Ottoman opera house that opened in 2021. The original AKM had been closed since a 2008 fire; its forced replacement under Erdoğan was widely read as a symbolic erasure of Kemalist identity, making both the abandonment and the replacement politically charged failures of cultural stewardship.
